pragma solidity ^0.8.17;

import {LibDiamond} from "./libraries/LibDiamond.sol";
import {IDiamondCut} from "./interfaces/IDiamondCut.sol";

// This is used in diamond constructor
// more arguments are added to this struct
// this avoids stack too deep errors
struct DiamondArgs {
  address owner;
  address init;
  bytes initCalldata;
}

contract FactTokenDiamond {
  constructor(IDiamondCut.FacetCut[] memory _diamondCut, DiamondArgs memory _args) {
    LibDiamond.setInititalContractOwner(_args.owner);
    LibDiamond.diamondCut(_diamondCut, _args.init, _args.initCalldata);
  }

  // Find facet for function that is called and execute the
  // function if a facet is found and return any value.
  fallback() external payable {
    LibDiamond.DiamondStorage storage ds = LibDiamond.diamondStorage();
    // get facet from function selector
    address facet = ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[msg.sig].facetAddress;
    require (facet != address(0), "DMND0015");
    
    // Execute external function from facet using delegatecall and return any value.
    assembly {
      // copy function selector and any arguments
      calldatacopy(0, 0, calldatasize())
      // execute function call using the facet
      let result := delegatecall(gas(), facet, 0, calldatasize(), 0, 0)
      // get any return value
      returndatacopy(0, 0, returndatasize())
      // return any return value or error back to the caller
      switch result
      case 0 {
        revert(0, returndatasize())
      }
      default {
        return(0, returndatasize())
      }
    }
  }

  receive() external payable {}
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.17;

/******************************************************************************\
* Author: Nick Mudge <nick@perfectabstractions.com> (https://twitter.com/mudgen)
* EIP-2535 Diamonds: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2535
/******************************************************************************/
import {IDiamond} from "../interfaces/IDiamond.sol";
import {IDiamondCut} from "../interfaces/IDiamondCut.sol";

// Remember to add the loupe functions from DiamondLoupeFacet to the diamond.
// The loupe functions are required by the EIP2535 Diamonds standard

library LibDiamond {
  bytes32 private constant DIAMOND_STORAGE_POSITION = keccak256("fact.diamond.storage");

  struct FacetAddressAndSelectorPosition {
    address facetAddress;
    uint16 selectorPosition;
  }

  struct DiamondStorage {
    // function selector => facet address and selector position in selectors array
    mapping(bytes4 => FacetAddressAndSelectorPosition) facetAddressAndSelectorPosition;
    bytes4[] selectors;
    mapping(bytes4 => bool) supportedInterfaces;
    // owner of the contract
    address contractOwner;
    // pending owner of the contract
    address pendingContractOwner;
  }

  function diamondStorage() internal pure returns (DiamondStorage storage ds) {
    bytes32 position = DIAMOND_STORAGE_POSITION;
    assembly {
      ds.slot := position
    }
  }

  event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

  event OwnershipTransferStarted(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

  function transferOwnership(address _newOwner) internal {
    require(_newOwner != address(0), "DMND0016");
    enforceIsContractOwner();
    setPendingContractOwner(_newOwner);
  }

  function acceptOwnership() internal {
    enforceIsPendingContractOwner();
    setContractOwner(pendingContractOwner());
  }

  function renounceOwnership() internal {
    enforceIsContractOwner();
    setContractOwner(address(0));
  }

  function setPendingContractOwner(address _newOwner) internal {
    DiamondStorage storage ds = diamondStorage();
    ds.pendingContractOwner = _newOwner;
    emit OwnershipTransferStarted(contractOwner(), _newOwner);
  }

  function setContractOwner(address _newOwner) internal {
    DiamondStorage storage ds = diamondStorage();
    address previousOwner = ds.contractOwner;
    ds.contractOwner = _newOwner;
    ds.pendingContractOwner = address(0);
    emit OwnershipTransferred(previousOwner, _newOwner);
  }

  function contractOwner() internal view returns (address contractOwner_) {
    contractOwner_ = diamondStorage().contractOwner;
  }

  function pendingContractOwner() internal view returns (address pendingContractOwner_) {
    pendingContractOwner_ = diamondStorage().pendingContractOwner;
  }

  function enforceIsContractOwner() internal view {
    require(msg.sender == contractOwner(), "DMND0001");
  }

  function enforceIsPendingContractOwner() internal view {
    require(msg.sender == pendingContractOwner(), "DMND0018");
  }

  event DiamondCut(IDiamondCut.FacetCut[] _diamondCut, address _init, bytes _calldata);

  // Internal function version of diamondCut
  function diamondCut(IDiamondCut.FacetCut[] memory _diamondCut, address _init, bytes memory _calldata) internal {
    for (uint256 facetIndex = 0; facetIndex < _diamondCut.length; facetIndex++) {
      bytes4[] memory functionSelectors = _diamondCut[facetIndex].functionSelectors;
      address facetAddress = _diamondCut[facetIndex].facetAddress;
      require(functionSelectors.length != 0, "DMND0002");

      IDiamondCut.FacetCutAction action = _diamondCut[facetIndex].action;
      if (action == IDiamond.FacetCutAction.Add) {
        addFunctions(facetAddress, functionSelectors);
      } else if (action == IDiamond.FacetCutAction.Replace) {
        replaceFunctions(facetAddress, functionSelectors);
      } else if (action == IDiamond.FacetCutAction.Remove) {
        removeFunctions(facetAddress, functionSelectors);
      } else {
        revert("DMND0005");
      }
    }
    emit DiamondCut(_diamondCut, _init, _calldata);
    initializeDiamondCut(_init, _calldata);
  }

  function addFunctions(address _facetAddress, bytes4[] memory _functionSelectors) internal {
    require(_facetAddress != address(0), "DMND0003");

    DiamondStorage storage ds = diamondStorage();
    uint16 selectorCount = uint16(ds.selectors.length);
    enforceHasContractCode(_facetAddress);
    for (uint256 selectorIndex = 0; selectorIndex < _functionSelectors.length; selectorIndex++) {
      bytes4 selector = _functionSelectors[selectorIndex];
      address oldFacetAddress = ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[selector].facetAddress;
      require(oldFacetAddress == address(0), "DMND0006");

      ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[selector] = FacetAddressAndSelectorPosition(_facetAddress, selectorCount);
      ds.selectors.push(selector);
      selectorCount++;
    }
  }

  function replaceFunctions(address _facetAddress, bytes4[] memory _functionSelectors) internal {
    DiamondStorage storage ds = diamondStorage();
    require(_facetAddress != address(0), "DMND0007");

    enforceHasContractCode(_facetAddress);
    for (uint256 selectorIndex; selectorIndex < _functionSelectors.length; selectorIndex++) {
      bytes4 selector = _functionSelectors[selectorIndex];
      address oldFacetAddress = ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[selector].facetAddress;
      
      // can't replace immutable functions -- functions defined directly in the diamond in this case
      require(oldFacetAddress != address(this), "DMND0008");
      require(oldFacetAddress != _facetAddress, "DMND0009");
      require(oldFacetAddress != address(0), "DMND0010");
      // replace old facet address
      ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[selector].facetAddress = _facetAddress;
    }
  }

  function removeFunctions(address _facetAddress, bytes4[] memory _functionSelectors) internal {
    DiamondStorage storage ds = diamondStorage();
    uint256 selectorCount = ds.selectors.length;
    require(_facetAddress == address(0), "DMND0011");

    for (uint256 selectorIndex; selectorIndex < _functionSelectors.length; selectorIndex++) {
      bytes4 selector = _functionSelectors[selectorIndex];
      FacetAddressAndSelectorPosition memory oldFacetAddressAndSelectorPosition = ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[
        selector
      ];
      require(oldFacetAddressAndSelectorPosition.facetAddress != address(0), "DMND0012");

      // can't remove immutable functions -- functions defined directly in the diamond
      require(oldFacetAddressAndSelectorPosition.facetAddress != address(this), "DMND0013");

      // replace selector with last selector
      selectorCount--;
      if (oldFacetAddressAndSelectorPosition.selectorPosition != selectorCount) {
        bytes4 lastSelector = ds.selectors[selectorCount];
        ds.selectors[oldFacetAddressAndSelectorPosition.selectorPosition] = lastSelector;
        ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[lastSelector].selectorPosition = oldFacetAddressAndSelectorPosition
          .selectorPosition;
      }
      // delete last selector
      ds.selectors.pop();
      delete ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[selector];
    }
  }

  function initializeDiamondCut(address _init, bytes memory _calldata) internal {
    if (_init == address(0)) {
      return;
    }
    enforceHasContractCode(_init);
    (bool success, bytes memory error) = _init.delegatecall(_calldata);
    if (!success) {
      if (error.length > 0) {
        // bubble up error
        /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
        assembly {
          let returndata_size := mload(error)
          revert(add(32, error), returndata_size)
        }
      } else {
        revert("DMND0014");
      }
    }
  }

  function enforceHasContractCode(address _contract) internal view {
    uint256 contractSize;
    assembly {
      contractSize := extcodesize(_contract)
    }
    require(contractSize != 0, "DMND0004");
  }

  function setInititalContractOwner(address _newOwner) internal {
    DiamondStorage storage ds = diamondStorage();
    ds.contractOwner = _newOwner;
  }
}

import {IAccessControl} from "../interfaces/IAccessControl.sol";
import {LibAccessControl} from "../libraries/LibAccessControl.sol";

contract AccessControlFacet is IAccessControl {
  constructor() {}

  modifier onlyRole(bytes32 role) {
    LibAccessControl._checkRole(role, msg.sender);
    _;
  }

  /**
   * @inheritdoc IAccessControl
   */
  function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view virtual returns (bool hasRole_) {
    return LibAccessControl._hasRole(role, account);
  }

  /**
   * @inheritdoc IAccessControl
   */
  function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view virtual returns (bytes32 role_) {
    return LibAccessControl._getRoleAdmin(role);
  }

  /**
   * @inheritdoc IAccessControl
   */
  function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address callerConfirmation) public virtual returns (bool success_) {
    require(callerConfirmation == msg.sender, "FACT0404");
    return LibAccessControl._revokeRole(role, callerConfirmation);
  }

  /**
   * @inheritdoc IAccessControl
   */
  function revokeRole(
    bytes32 role,
    address account
  ) public virtual onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) returns (bool success_) {
    return LibAccessControl._revokeRole(role, account);
  }

  /**
   * @inheritdoc IAccessControl
   */
  function grantRole(
    bytes32 role,
    address account
  ) public virtual onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) returns (bool success_) {
    return LibAccessControl._grantRole(role, account);
  }
}

    bytes32 requestId_,
    address requester_,
    uint256 amount_
  ) public virtual override whenNotPaused onlyTokenizationAgent returns (bool success_) {
    LibBurnable._burn(requestId_, requester_, amount_);
    return true;
  }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.17;
/******************************************************************************\
* Author: Nick Mudge <nick@perfectabstractions.com> (https://twitter.com/mudgen)
* EIP-2535 Diamonds: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2535
/******************************************************************************/

// The functions in DiamondLoupeFacet MUST be added to a diamond.
// The EIP-2535 Diamond standard requires these functions.

import {LibDiamond} from "../libraries/LibDiamond.sol";
import {IDiamondLoupe} from "../interfaces/IDiamondLoupe.sol";

contract DiamondLoupeFacet is IDiamondLoupe {
  constructor() {}

  // Diamond Loupe Functions
  ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  /// These functions are expected to be called frequently by tools.
  //
  // struct Facet {
  //     address facetAddress;
  //     bytes4[] functionSelectors;
  // }
  /// @notice Gets all facets and their selectors.
  /// @return facets_ Facet
  function facets() external view override returns (Facet[] memory facets_) {
    LibDiamond.DiamondStorage storage ds = LibDiamond.diamondStorage();
    uint256 selectorCount = ds.selectors.length;
    // create an array set to the maximum size possible
    facets_ = new Facet[](selectorCount);
    // create an array for counting the number of selectors for each facet
    uint16[] memory numFacetSelectors = new uint16[](selectorCount);
    // total number of facets
    uint256 numFacets;
    // loop through function selectors
    for (uint256 selectorIndex; selectorIndex < selectorCount; selectorIndex++) {
      bytes4 selector = ds.selectors[selectorIndex];
      address facetAddress_ = ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[selector].facetAddress;
      bool continueLoop = false;
      // find the functionSelectors array for selector and add selector to it
      for (uint256 facetIndex; facetIndex < numFacets; facetIndex++) {
        if (facets_[facetIndex].facetAddress == facetAddress_) {
          facets_[facetIndex].functionSelectors[numFacetSelectors[facetIndex]] = selector;
          numFacetSelectors[facetIndex]++;
          continueLoop = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      // if functionSelectors array exists for selector then continue loop
      if (continueLoop) {
        continueLoop = false;
        continue;
      }
      // create a new functionSelectors array for selector
      facets_[numFacets].facetAddress = facetAddress_;
      facets_[numFacets].functionSelectors = new bytes4[](selectorCount);
      facets_[numFacets].functionSelectors[0] = selector;
      numFacetSelectors[numFacets] = 1;
      numFacets++;
    }
    for (uint256 facetIndex; facetIndex < numFacets; facetIndex++) {
      uint256 numSelectors = numFacetSelectors[facetIndex];
      bytes4[] memory selectors = facets_[facetIndex].functionSelectors;
      // setting the number of selectors
      assembly {
        mstore(selectors, numSelectors)
      }
    }
    // setting the number of facets
    assembly {
      mstore(facets_, numFacets)
    }
  }

  /// @notice Gets all the function selectors supported by a specific facet.
  /// @param _facet The facet address.
  /// @return facetFunctionSelectors_ The selectors associated with a facet address.
  function facetFunctionSelectors(
    address _facet
  ) external view override returns (bytes4[] memory facetFunctionSelectors_) {
    LibDiamond.DiamondStorage storage ds = LibDiamond.diamondStorage();
    uint256 selectorCount = ds.selectors.length;
    uint256 numSelectors;
    facetFunctionSelectors_ = new bytes4[](selectorCount);
    // loop through function selectors
    for (uint256 selectorIndex; selectorIndex < selectorCount; selectorIndex++) {
      bytes4 selector = ds.selectors[selectorIndex];
      address facetAddress_ = ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[selector].facetAddress;
      if (_facet == facetAddress_) {
        facetFunctionSelectors_[numSelectors] = selector;
        numSelectors++;
      }
    }
    // Set the number of selectors in the array
    assembly {
      mstore(facetFunctionSelectors_, numSelectors)
    }
  }

  /// @notice Get all the facet addresses used by a diamond.
  /// @return facetAddresses_
  function facetAddresses() external view override returns (address[] memory facetAddresses_) {
    LibDiamond.DiamondStorage storage ds = LibDiamond.diamondStorage();
    uint256 selectorCount = ds.selectors.length;
    // create an array set to the maximum size possible
    facetAddresses_ = new address[](selectorCount);
    uint256 numFacets;
    // loop through function selectors
    for (uint256 selectorIndex; selectorIndex < selectorCount; selectorIndex++) {
      bytes4 selector = ds.selectors[selectorIndex];
      address facetAddress_ = ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[selector].facetAddress;
      bool continueLoop = false;
      // see if we have collected the address already and break out of loop if we have
      for (uint256 facetIndex; facetIndex < numFacets; facetIndex++) {
        if (facetAddress_ == facetAddresses_[facetIndex]) {
          continueLoop = true;
          break;
        }
      }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.17;

import {ERC20Facet} from "../../ERC20Facet.sol";
import {LibERC20} from "../../../libraries/LibERC20.sol";
import {LibFactBase} from "../../../libraries/LibFactBase.sol";
import {LibBurnRequestable} from "../../../libraries/LibBurnRequestable.sol";
import {LibAccessControl} from "../../../libraries/LibAccessControl.sol";

contract ERC20FacetTransferBurnable is ERC20Facet {
  constructor() {}

  /**
   * @inheritdoc ERC20Facet
   *
   * @notice If to_ is a burner, a burn request along side the transfer
   * @notice Transfers to burner addresses will not check the active status of the to_ account
   *
   * @dev MUST revert if contract is paused
   * @dev MUST revert if msg.sender balance < amount_
   * @dev MUST revert if token is inactive
   * @dev MUST revert if msg.sender is deactivated
   * @dev MUST revert if to_ is deactivated only if to_ is not a burner
   * @dev MUST revert if msg.sender is the zero address
   * @dev MUST revert if to_ is the zero address
   */
  function transfer(
    address to_,
    uint256 amount_
  ) public virtual override whenNotPaused whenActiveToken onlyActiveAccount(msg.sender) returns (bool success_) {
    if (_isBurner(to_)) {
      bytes32 requestId = _generateBurnRequestId(msg.sender, to_, amount_);
      LibBurnRequestable._createBurnRequest(msg.sender, amount_, requestId, to_);
      LibERC20._transfer(msg.sender, to_, amount_);
    } else {
      super.transfer(to_, amount_);
    }
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * @inheritdoc ERC20Facet
   *
   * @notice If to_ is a burner, a burn request along side the transferFrom
   * @notice Transfers to burner addresses will not check the active status of the to_ account
   * @notice When transfering to burner address, updates allowance, NOT burnAllowance upon successful transferFrom
   *
   * @dev MUST revert if contract is paused
   * @dev MUST revert if msg.sender allowance for from_ < amount_
   * @dev MUST revert if from_ balance < amount_
   * @dev MUST revert if token is inactive
   * @dev MUST revert if msg.sender is deactivated
   * @dev MUST revert if from_ is deactivated
   * @dev MUST revert if to_ is deactivated only if to_ is not a burner
   * @dev MUST revert if msg.sender is the zero address
   * @dev MUST revert if from_ is the zero address
   * @dev MUST revert if to_ is the zero address
   * @dev MUST update allowance after successful transfer
   */
  function transferFrom(
    address from_,
    address to_,
    uint256 amount_
  )
    public
    virtual
    override
    whenNotPaused
    whenActiveToken
    onlyActiveAccount(from_)
    onlyActiveAccount(msg.sender)
    returns (bool success_)
  {
    if (_isBurner(to_)) {
      LibERC20._spendAllowance(from_, msg.sender, amount_);
      bytes32 requestId = _generateBurnRequestId(from_, to_, amount_);
      LibBurnRequestable._createBurnRequest(from_, amount_, requestId, to_);
      LibERC20._transfer(from_, to_, amount_);
    } else {
      super.transferFrom(from_, to_, amount_);
    }
    return true;
  }

  function _isBurner(address burner) internal view returns (bool) {
    return LibAccessControl._hasRole(LibFactBase.BURNER, burner);
  }

  function _generateBurnRequestId(
    address from_,
    address to_,

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

pragma solidity ^0.8.17;

/**
 * @title Token Timelock Interface
 * @author Kinexys Digital Assets Engineering
 * @notice Simple interface defining methods needed to allow the token to have timelock functionalities
 */
interface ITimelockable {
  /**
   * @notice Event is emitted whenever a caller_ sets a new timelock delay
   * @dev MUST trigger when the timelock delay is set
   * @param caller_ address which has set the new timelock delay
   * @param oldDelay_ previous timelock delay in seconds
   * @param newDelay_ new timelock delay in seconds
   */
  event TimelockDelaySet(address indexed caller_, uint256 oldDelay_, uint256 newDelay_);

  /**
   * @notice Event is emitted whenever a caller_ queues a transaction to be executed after the timelock delay
   * @dev MUST trigger when a transaction is queued
   * @param selector_ function selector to be called
   * @param data_ calldata to be sent to the function to be called
   * @param caller_ address which has queued the transaction
   * @param eta_ timestamp at which the transaction will be executable
   */
  event TransactionQueued(bytes4 indexed selector_, bytes data_, address indexed caller_, uint256 eta_);

  /**
   * @notice Event is emitted whenever a caller_ cancels a queued transaction
   * @dev MUST trigger when a transaction is cancelled
   * @param selector_ function selector to be called
   * @param data_ calldata to be sent to the function to be called
   * @param caller_ address which has queued the transaction
   * @param eta_ timestamp at which the transaction was supposed to be executable
   */
  event TransactionCancelled(bytes4 indexed selector_, bytes data_, address indexed caller_, uint256 eta_);

  /**
   * @notice Event is emitted whenever an admin revokes a queued transaction
   * @dev MUST trigger when a transaction is revoked
   * @param selector_ function selector to be called
   * @param data_ calldata to be sent to the function to be called
   * @param caller_ address which has queued the transaction
   * @param eta_ timestamp at which the transaction was supposed to be executable
   */

  event TransactionRevoked(bytes4 indexed selector_, bytes data_, address indexed caller_, uint256 eta_);

  /**
   * @notice Event is emitted whenever a caller_ sucessfully calls a timelock-protected function
   * @dev MUST trigger when the timelock-protected function is executed
   * @param selector_ function selector to be called
   * @param data_ calldata to be sent to the function to be called
   * @param caller_ address which has queued the transaction
   * @param eta_ timestamp from which the transaction was supposed to be executable
   */

  event TransactionExecuted(bytes4 indexed selector_, bytes data_, address indexed caller_, uint256 eta_);

  /**
   * @notice Admin function to set the timelock delay
   * @dev MUST be called by an authorized role
   * @param delay_ new timelock delay in seconds
   * @return success_ true if the operation was successful
   */
  function setDelay(uint256 delay_) external returns (bool success_);

  /**
   * @notice Get the current timelock delay
   * @return delay_ current timelock delay in seconds
   */
  function getDelay() external view returns (uint256 delay_);

/// @title ERC-173 Contract Ownership Standard

/* is ERC165 */
interface IERC173 {
  /// @dev This emits when ownership of a contract changes
  event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

  /// @dev This emits when transfer of ownership of a contract is initiated
  event OwnershipTransferStarted(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

  /// @notice Get the address of the owner. If there is no owner, returns the zero address
  /// @return owner_ The address of the owner
  function owner() external view returns (address owner_);

  /// @notice Get the address of the pending owner. If no ownership transfer is pending,
  /// this returns the zero address
  /// @dev The returned pending owner value does not indicate that the address is valid
  /// @return pendingOwner_ The address of the owner

  /// @dev Cannot renounce ownership using this function

  /// @dev MUST emit OwnershipTransferStarted event

  function transferOwnership(address _newOwner) external;

  /// @dev Will revert if called by any account other than the pending new owner

/**

interface IERC20 {
  /**
   * @notice Event is emitted whenever a token is transferred from one account to another
   * @dev Event is only emitted when the transfer is "usual" and not under "managed" circumstances
   *
   * @param from_ address from which tokens are moved from
   * @param to_ address from which tokens are moved to
   * @param amount_ number of tokens which are moved
   */
  event Transfer(address indexed from_, address indexed to_, uint256 amount_);

  /**
   * @notice Event is emitted when some address is allowed to move some tokens on the owner's behalf
   * @dev Event is only emitted when the transfer is "usual" and not under "managed" circumstances
   *
   * @param owner_ address of owner tokens from which approval is granted
   * @param spender_ address approved to some tokens from the owner's address
   * @param amount_ amount of tokens which are approved to be moved
   */
  event Approval(address indexed owner_, address indexed spender_, uint256 amount_);

  /**
   * @notice Name of the token represented by this contract
   * @dev Name will most likely be the asset "long name" or equivalent
   *
   * @return name_ name of the token
   */
  function name() external view returns (string memory name_);

  /**
   * @notice Symbol of the token represented by this contract
   * @dev Symbol will most likely be the asset ISIN or equivalent
   *
   * @return symbol_ symbol of the token
   */
  function symbol() external view returns (string memory symbol_);

  /**
   * @notice Number of decimals (significant digits) the token supports
   * @dev The default value for this is 18, but modify based on asset's atomic unit requirements
   *
   * @return decimals_ number of decimal points supported by the token
   */
  function decimals() external view returns (uint8 decimals_);

  /**
   * @notice Total supply of tokens minted in this contract
   * @dev Total supply does not change for tokens that are "pending" some other action (e.g. locked)
   *
   * @return totalSupply_ total number of tokens that have been minted
   */
  function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256 totalSupply_);

  /**
   * @notice Query for the token balance of some address
   * @dev Only "usable" balance amount will be returned, and not those that are "locked up"
   *
   * @param owner_ the address of the owner of the balance
   * @return balance_ number of tokens belonging to the address
   */
  function balanceOf(address owner_) external view returns (uint256 balance_);

  /**
   * @notice Transfer tokens from sender address to another address
   * @dev Implementation must satisfy all pre-checks
   *
   * @param to_ address to which tokens are moved
   * @param amount_ amount of tokens to be moved
   * @return success_ status of transfer (true/false)
   */
  function transfer(address to_, uint256 amount_) external returns (bool success_);

  /**
   * @notice Transfer tokens from some account to another account
   * @dev Implementation must satisfy all pre-checks and respect approved amount
   *
   * @param from_ address from which tokens are moved
   * @param to_ address to which tokens are moved
   * @param amount_ amount of tokens to be moved
   * @return success_ status of transfer (true/false)
   */
  function transferFrom(address from_, address to_, uint256 amount_) external returns (bool success_);

  /**
   * @notice Approve some address to move some tokens on sender's behalf
   * @dev Implementation must satisfy all pre-checks. The amount approved will replace the existing amount.
   *
   * @param spender_ address to be authorized to move tokens from the sender address
   * @param amount_ amount of tokens to be moved
   * @return success_ status of transfer (true/false)
   */
  function approve(address spender_, uint256 amount_) external returns (bool success_);

  /**
   * @notice Remaining tokens that can be moved on sender's behalf by another address
   * @dev Only "usable" approved amount will be returned, and not those that are "locked up"
   *
   * @param owner_ the address of the owner of the balance
   * @param spender_ address to be authorized to move tokens from the sender address
   * @return remaining_ number of tokens that is remaining and is authorized to be moved
   */
  function allowance(address owner_, address spender_) external view returns (uint256 remaining_);
}

/**
 * @title Managed Token Interface
 * @author Kinexys Digital Assets Engineering
 * @notice Simple interface defining administrative functions to manage tokens
 * @dev Allows tokens in balance to be managed by an authorized user
 */
interface IManagedAccount {
  /**
   * @notice Event signaling that an address is activated (e.g. sanctions lifted)
   * @dev MUST trigger when the account status is changed from deactivated to activated
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that activated another address
   * @param account_ address that is activated
   */
  event AccountActivated(address indexed caller_, address indexed account_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signaling that an address is activated (e.g. sanctions)
   * @dev MUST trigger when the address status is changed from activated to deactivated
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that deactivated another address
   * @param account_ address that is deactivated
   */
  event AccountDeactivated(address indexed caller_, address indexed account_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signaling that some addresses are activated for business reasons (e.g. sanctions lifted)
   * @dev MUST trigger when the address' statuses are changed from deactivated to activated
   *
   * @param caller_  authorized address that activated a number of addresses
   * @param accounts_ addresses that are activated
   */
  event AccountActivatedBatch(address caller_, address[] accounts_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signaling that some addresses are deactivated for business reasons (e.g. sanctions)
   * @dev MUST trigger when the address' statuses are changed from activated to deactivated
   *
   * @param caller_  authorized address that deactivated a number of addresses
   * @param accounts_ addresses that are deactivated
   */
  event AccountDeactivatedBatch(address caller_, address[] accounts_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of an address's tokens are locked for business reasons (e.g. default)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected address is locked
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that locked some tokens
   * @param owner_ address from which tokens were locked
   * @param amount_ number of tokens that have been locked
   */
  event Locked(address indexed caller_, address indexed owner_, uint256 amount_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of an address' tokens are locked for business reasons (e.g. default)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected addresses are locked
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that locked some tokens
   * @param owners_ addresses from which tokens were locked
   * @param amounts_ number of tokens from each address that have been locked
   */
  event LockedBatch(address indexed caller_, address[] owners_, uint256[] amounts_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of an address's tokens are unlocked for business reasons (e.g. default)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected address is unlocked
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that locked some tokens
   * @param owner_ address from which tokens were unlocked
   * @param amount_ number of tokens that have been unlocked
   */
  event Unlocked(address indexed caller_, address indexed owner_, uint256 amount_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of an address' tokens are unlocked for business reasons (e.g. default)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected addresses are unlocked
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that locked some tokens
   * @param owners_ addresses from which tokens were unlocked
   * @param amounts_ number of tokens from each address that have been unlocked
   */
  event UnlockedBatch(address indexed caller_, address[] owners_, uint256[] amounts_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of an address's tokens are forcibly burned (e.g. off-chain reconciliation)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected address is force burned
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that force burned some tokens
   * @param owner_ address from which tokens were force burned
   * @param amount_ number of tokens from that have been force burned
   */
  event ForceBurned(address indexed caller_, address indexed owner_, uint256 amount_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of address' tokens are forcibly burned (e.g. off-chain reconciliation)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected addresses are force burned
   * @param caller_ authorized address that locked some tokens
   * @param owners_ addresses from which tokens were force burned
   * @param amounts_ number of tokens from each address that have been force burned
   */
  event ForceBurnedBatch(address indexed caller_, address[] owners_, uint256[] amounts_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of an address's tokens are forcibly transferred (e.g. off-chain reconciliation)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected address is force transferred
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that force transfers some tokens
   * @param owner_ address from which tokens were force transferred
   * @param newOwner_ address to which tokens were force transferred
   * @param amount_ number of tokens from that have been force transferred
   */
  event ForceTransferred(address indexed caller_, address indexed owner_, address indexed newOwner_, uint256 amount_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of address' tokens are forcibly transferred (e.g. off-chain reconciliation)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected addresses are force transferred
   * @param caller_ authorized address that force transfers some tokens
   * @param owners_ addresses from which tokens were force transferred
   * @param newOwners_ addresses to which tokens were force transferred
   * @param amounts_ number of tokens from each address that have been force transferred
   */
  event ForceTransferredBatch(address indexed caller_, address[] owners_, address[] newOwners_, uint256[] amounts_);

  /**
   * @notice Queries an address's status
   *
   * @param owner_ address of the account to be activated
   * @return active_ status of the address (true/false)
   */
  function accountActive(address owner_) external view returns (bool active_);

  /**
   * @notice Queries a number of address' statuses
   *
   * @param owners_ addresses of the accounts to be activated
   * @return actives_ status of the addresses (true/false)
   */
  function batchAccountActive(address[] calldata owners_) external view returns (bool[] memory actives_);

  /**
   * @notice Activate the address and enable regular business processes (e.g. sanctions lifted)
   *
   * @param owner_ address of the account to be activated
   * @return success_ status of the transaction (true/false)
   */
  function activateAccount(address owner_) external returns (bool success_);

  /**
   * @notice Activate a number of addresses and enable regular business processes (e.g. sanctions lifted)
   *
   * @param owners_ addresses of the accounts to be activated
   * @return success_ status of the transaction (true/false)
   */
  function batchActivateAccount(address[] calldata owners_) external returns (bool success_);

  /**
   * @notice Deactivate the address and disable regular business processes (e.g. sanctions)
   *
   * @param owner_ address of the account to be deactivated
   * @return success_ status of the transaction (true/false)
   */
  function deactivateAccount(address owner_) external returns (bool success_);

  /**
   * @notice Deactivate the address and disable regular business processes (e.g. sanctions)
   *
   * @param owners_ addresses of the accounts to be deactivated
   * @return success_ status of the transaction (true/false)
   */
  function batchDeactivateAccount(address[] calldata owners_) external returns (bool success_);

   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that activated another address
   * @param account_ address that is activated

  event AccountActivated(address indexed caller_, address indexed account_);

  /**

   * @dev MUST trigger when the address status is changed from activated to deactivated
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that deactivated another address

   */
  event AccountDeactivated(address indexed caller_, address indexed account_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signaling that some addresses are activated for business reasons (e.g. sanctions lifted)
   * @dev MUST trigger when the address' statuses are changed from deactivated to activated
   *
   * @param caller_  authorized address that activated a number of addresses
   * @param accounts_ addresses that are activated
   */
  event AccountActivatedBatch(address caller_, address[] accounts_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signaling that some addresses are deactivated for business reasons (e.g. sanctions)
   * @dev MUST trigger when the address' statuses are changed from activated to deactivated
   *
   * @param caller_  authorized address that deactivated a number of addresses
   * @param accounts_ addresses that are deactivated
   */
  event AccountDeactivatedBatch(address caller_, address[] accounts_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of an address's tokens are locked for business reasons (e.g. default)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected address is locked
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that locked some tokens
   * @param owner_ address from which tokens were locked
   * @param amount_ number of tokens that have been locked
   */
  event Locked(address indexed caller_, address indexed owner_, uint256 amount_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of an address' tokens are locked for business reasons (e.g. default)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected addresses are locked
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that locked some tokens
   * @param owners_ addresses from which tokens were locked
   * @param amounts_ number of tokens from each address that have been locked
   */
  event LockedBatch(address indexed caller_, address[] owners_, uint256[] amounts_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of an address's tokens are unlocked for business reasons (e.g. default)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected address is unlocked
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that locked some tokens
   * @param owner_ address from which tokens were unlocked
   * @param amount_ number of tokens that have been unlocked
   */
  event Unlocked(address indexed caller_, address indexed owner_, uint256 amount_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of an address' tokens are unlocked for business reasons (e.g. default)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected addresses are unlocked
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that locked some tokens
   * @param owners_ addresses from which tokens were unlocked
   * @param amounts_ number of tokens from each address that have been unlocked
   */
  event UnlockedBatch(address indexed caller_, address[] owners_, uint256[] amounts_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of an address's tokens are forcibly burned (e.g. off-chain reconciliation)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected address is force burned
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that force burned some tokens
   * @param owner_ address from which tokens were force burned
   * @param amount_ number of tokens from that have been force burned
   */
  event ForceBurned(address indexed caller_, address indexed owner_, uint256 amount_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of address' tokens are forcibly burned (e.g. off-chain reconciliation)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected addresses are force burned
   * @param caller_ authorized address that locked some tokens
   * @param owners_ addresses from which tokens were force burned
   * @param amounts_ number of tokens from each address that have been force burned
   */
  event ForceBurnedBatch(address indexed caller_, address[] owners_, uint256[] amounts_);

   * @notice Event signals an amount of an address's tokens are forcibly transferred (e.g. off-chain reconciliation)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected address is force transferred
   *
   * @param caller_ authorized address that force transfers some tokens
   * @param owner_ address from which tokens were force transferred
   * @param newOwner_ address to which tokens were force transferred
   * @param amount_ number of tokens from that have been force transferred
   */
  event ForceTransferred(address indexed caller_, address indexed owner_, address indexed newOwner_, uint256 amount_);

  /**
   * @notice Event signals an amount of address' tokens are forcibly transferred (e.g. off-chain reconciliation)
   * @dev MUST trigger when some tokens for the affected addresses are force transferred
   * @param caller_ authorized address that force transfers some tokens
   * @param owners_ addresses from which tokens were force transferred
   * @param newOwners_ addresses to which tokens were force transferred
   * @param amounts_ number of tokens from each address that have been force transferred

   * @notice Queries a number of address' statuses
   *
   * @param owners_ addresses of the accounts to be activated
   * @return actives_ status of the addresses (true/false)
   */

   *
   * @param owners_ addresses of the accounts to be activated

   *
   * @param owner_ address of the account to be deactivated
   * @return success_ status of the transaction (true/false)

   *
   * @param owners_ addresses of the accounts to be deactivated
   * @return success_ status of the transaction (true/false)
   */
  function batchDeactivateAccount(address[] calldata owners_) external returns (bool success_);

   * @param owner_ the address of the owner of the locked balance
   * @return balance_ number of locked tokens belonging to the address

   *
   * @param owner_ the address of the owner for which tokens are locked
   * @param amount_ the number of tokens to be locked
   * @return success_ status of the locking of the tokens (true/false)
   */

  /**
   * @notice Lock a number of tokens for each address
   * @dev MUST lock up ONLY to the total token balance of the address
   *      MUST fail and rollback if ANY lock fails
   *
   * @param owners_ the addresses of the owners for which tokens are locked
   * @param amounts_ the number of tokens to be locked for each address
   * @return success_ status of the locking of the tokens (true/false)
   */
  function batchLock(address[] calldata owners_, uint256[] calldata amounts_) external returns (bool success_);

  /**
   * @notice Unlock a number of tokens for an address
   * @dev MUST lock up ONLY to the total locked token balance of the address
   *
   * @param owner_ the address of the owner for which tokens are unlocked
   * @param amount_ the number of tokens to be unlocked
   * @return success_ status of the unlocking of the tokens (true/false)
   */
  function unlock(address owner_, uint256 amount_) external returns (bool success_);

  /**
   * @notice Unlock a number of tokens for each address
   * @dev MUST lock up ONLY to the total locked token balance of the address
   *      MUST fail and rollback if ANY unlock fails
   *
   * @param owners_ the addresses of the owners for which tokens are unlocked
   * @param amounts_ the number of tokens to be unlocked for each address
   * @return success_ status of the unlocking of the tokens (true/false)
   */
  function batchUnlock(address[] calldata owners_, uint256[] calldata amounts_) external returns (bool success_);

   * @notice Force burn a number of tokens for an address
   * @dev MUST only be able to force burn balances that have been burnt
   *
   * @param owner_ the address of the owner for which tokens are force burned
   * @param amount_ the number of tokens to be burned

   *

   *
   * @param owner_ the address of the owner for which tokens are transferred
   * @param newOwner_ the address of which locked tokens are transferred to

   *
   * @param owners_ the addresses of the owners for which tokens are transferred
   * @param amounts_ the number of tokens to be force transferred for each address

   */
  function batchForceTransfer(

  ) external returns (bool success_);
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.17;

library LibTimelockable {
  bytes32 private constant TIMELOCKABLE_STORAGE_POSITION = keccak256("fact.timelockable.storage");

  uint256 private constant MINIMUM_TIMELOCK_DELAY = 12 minutes;

  uint256 private constant MAXIMUM_TIMELOCK_DELAY = 24 hours;

  uint256 private constant GRACE_PERIOD = 24 hours;

  struct TimelockStorage {
    mapping(bytes32 => uint256) _queuedTransactions;
    uint256 _timelockDelay;
  }

  event TimelockDelaySet(address indexed caller_, uint256 oldDelay_, uint256 newDelay_);

  event TransactionQueued(bytes4 indexed selector_, bytes data_, address indexed caller_, uint256 eta_);

  event TransactionCancelled(bytes4 indexed selector_, bytes data_, address indexed caller_, uint256 eta_);

  event TransactionRevoked(bytes4 indexed selector_, bytes data_, address indexed caller_, uint256 eta_);

  event TransactionExecuted(bytes4 indexed selector_, bytes data_, address indexed caller_, uint256 eta_);

  function ref() internal pure returns (TimelockStorage storage s) {
    bytes32 position = TIMELOCKABLE_STORAGE_POSITION;
    assembly {
      s.slot := position
    }
  }

  function _setTimelockDelay(uint256 delay_, address caller_) internal returns (bool success_) {
    require((delay_ >= MINIMUM_TIMELOCK_DELAY) && (MAXIMUM_TIMELOCK_DELAY >= delay_), "FACT1000");
    uint256 oldDelay = ref()._timelockDelay;
    ref()._timelockDelay = delay_;
    emit TimelockDelaySet(caller_, oldDelay, delay_);
    return true;
  }

  function _queueTransaction(bytes4 selector_, bytes calldata data_, address caller_) internal returns (bool success_) {
    uint256 eta = block.timestamp + ref()._timelockDelay;
    bytes32 transactionID = _getTransactionID(selector_, data_, caller_);
    require(ref()._queuedTransactions[transactionID] == 0, "FACT1001");
    ref()._queuedTransactions[transactionID] = eta;
    emit TransactionQueued(selector_, data_, caller_, eta);
    return true;
  }

  function _cancelTransaction(
    bytes4 selector_,
    bytes calldata data_,
    address caller_
  ) internal returns (bool success_) {
    bytes32 transactionID = _getTransactionID(selector_, data_, caller_);
    require(ref()._queuedTransactions[transactionID] != 0, "FACT1002");

    uint256 eta = ref()._queuedTransactions[transactionID];
    _clearQueuedTransaction(transactionID);
    emit TransactionCancelled(selector_, data_, caller_, eta);
    return true;
  }

  function _revokeTransaction(
    bytes4 selector_,
    bytes calldata data_,
    address caller_
  ) internal returns (bool success_) {
    bytes32 transactionID = _getTransactionID(selector_, data_, caller_);
    require(ref()._queuedTransactions[transactionID] != 0, "FACT1003");

    uint256 eta = ref()._queuedTransactions[transactionID];
    _clearQueuedTransaction(transactionID);
    emit TransactionRevoked(selector_, data_, caller_, eta);
    return true;
  }

  function _executeTransaction(
    bytes4 selector_,
    bytes calldata data_,
    address caller_
  ) internal returns (bool success_) {
    bytes32 transactionID = _getTransactionID(selector_, data_, caller_);
    require(_isExecutable(selector_, data_, caller_), "FACT1004");

    uint256 eta = ref()._queuedTransactions[transactionID];
    _clearQueuedTransaction(transactionID);
    emit TransactionExecuted(selector_, data_, caller_, eta);
    return true;
  }

  function _executableAt(bytes4 selector_, bytes calldata data_, address caller_) internal view returns (uint256 eta_) {
    bytes32 transactionID = _getTransactionID(selector_, data_, caller_);
    return ref()._queuedTransactions[transactionID];
  }

  function _isExecutable(
    bytes4 selector_,
    bytes calldata data_,
    address caller_
  ) internal view returns (bool callable_) {
    bytes32 transactionID = _getTransactionID(selector_, data_, caller_);
    uint256 eta = ref()._queuedTransactions[transactionID];
    callable_ = (eta != 0 && block.timestamp >= eta && block.timestamp <= eta + GRACE_PERIOD);
  }

  function _getTransactionID(
    bytes4 selector_,
    bytes calldata data_,
    address caller_
  ) internal pure returns (bytes32 transactionID_) {
    transactionID_ = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(selector_, data_, caller_));
  }

  function _clearQueuedTransaction(bytes32 transactionID) internal {
    delete ref()._queuedTransactions[transactionID];
  }
}

library LibAccessControl {
  bytes32 private constant ACCESS_STORAGE_POSITION = keccak256("fact.accesscontrol.storage");
  bytes32 private constant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = 0x00;

  event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);

  event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);

  event RoleAdminChanged(bytes32 indexed role, bytes32 indexed previousAdminRole, bytes32 indexed newAdminRole);

  struct RoleData {
    mapping(address => bool) hasRole;
    bytes32 adminRole;
  }

  struct AccessControlStorage {
    mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) _roles;
  }

  function ref() internal pure returns (AccessControlStorage storage s) {
    bytes32 position = ACCESS_STORAGE_POSITION;
    assembly {
      s.slot := position
    }
  }

  function _hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal view returns (bool) {
    return ref()._roles[role].hasRole[account];
  }

  function _getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) internal view returns (bytes32) {
    return ref()._roles[role].adminRole;
  }

  function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal returns (bool) {
    if (!_hasRole(role, account)) {
      ref()._roles[role].hasRole[account] = true;
      emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
      return true;
    } else {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal returns (bool) {
    if (_hasRole(role, account)) {
      ref()._roles[role].hasRole[account] = false;
      emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
      return true;
    } else {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function _checkRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal view {
    require(_hasRole(role, account), "FACT0403");
  }

  function _setRoleAdmin(bytes32 role, bytes32 adminRole) internal {
    bytes32 previousAdminRole = _getRoleAdmin(role);
    ref()._roles[role].adminRole = adminRole;
    emit RoleAdminChanged(role, previousAdminRole, adminRole);
  }

  function _getDefaultAdminRole() internal pure returns (bytes32) {
    return DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE;
  }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.17;

import {LibFactBase} from "../libraries/LibFactBase.sol";
import {LibERC20} from "../libraries/LibERC20.sol";

library LibBurnRequestable {
  bytes32 private constant BURN_REQUESTABLE_STORAGE_POSITION = keccak256("fact.burnrequestable.storage");

  struct BurnRequestableStorage {
    /**
     * @notice Balance of tokens that have been requested to be burned but have not been confirmed
     * @dev Represent a number of tokens that are part of the total supply but may be removed
     */
    mapping(address => uint256) _burnBalances;
    /**
     * @notice Burn allowance
     * @dev The number of tokens that are allowed to be burned CAN be greater than existing token balance
     */
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) _burnAllowances;
  }

  event BurnRequested(bytes32 indexed requestId_, address indexed requester_, address burner_, uint256 amount_);

  event BurnApproved(
    bytes32 indexed requestId_,
    address indexed requester_,
    address indexed responder_,
    address burner_,
    uint256 amount_
  );

  event BurnRejected(
    bytes32 indexed requestId_,
    address indexed requester_,
    address indexed responder_,
    address burner_,
    uint256 amount_
  );

  event RequestBurnApproval(address indexed requester_, address indexed delegate_, uint256 amount_);

  function ref() internal pure returns (BurnRequestableStorage storage s) {
    bytes32 position = BURN_REQUESTABLE_STORAGE_POSITION;
    assembly {
      s.slot := position
    }
  }

  function _requestBurn(bytes32 requestId_, address burner_, uint256 amount_) internal {
    require(amount_ > 0, "FACT0700");
    require(amount_ <= LibERC20.ref()._balances[msg.sender], "FACT0708");

    _createBurnRequest(msg.sender, amount_, requestId_, burner_);
    LibERC20._transfer(msg.sender, burner_, amount_);
  }

  function _requestBurnFrom(
    bytes32 requestId_,
    address requester_,
    address delegate_,
    address burner_,
    uint256 amount_
  ) internal {
    require(requester_ != address(0), "FACT0707");
    require(delegate_ != address(0), "FACT0706");
    require(amount_ > 0, "FACT0700");
    require(amount_ <= LibERC20.ref()._balances[requester_], "FACT0708");

    _decreaseRequestBurnAllowance(requester_, delegate_, amount_);
    _createBurnRequest(requester_, amount_, requestId_, burner_);
    LibERC20._transfer(requester_, burner_, amount_);
  }

  function _prepareBurn(bytes32 requestId_, address requester_, address burner_, uint256 amount_) internal {
    require(requester_ != address(0), "FACT0707");
    require(amount_ > 0, "FACT0700");
    require(amount_ <= LibERC20.ref()._balances[requester_], "FACT0708");

    _createBurnRequest(requester_, amount_, requestId_, burner_);
    LibERC20._transfer(requester_, burner_, amount_);
  }

  function _approveBurn(bytes32 requestId_, address requester_) internal {
    bytes32 internalRequestId = LibFactBase._generateID(requestId_, requester_);
    LibFactBase.Request memory request = LibFactBase._getRequest(internalRequestId);
    require(request.requester == requester_, "FACT0701");
    require(request.requestStatus == LibFactBase.RequestStatus.PENDING, "FACT0701");
    require(request.requestType == LibFactBase.RequestType.BURN, "FACT0709");
    request.responder = msg.sender;
    request.requestStatus = LibFactBase.RequestStatus.APPROVED;

    LibFactBase.ref()._requests[request.requestId] = request;
    LibERC20.ref()._balances[request.burnFrom] -= request.amount;
    LibERC20.ref()._totalSupply -= request.amount;

    emit BurnApproved(requestId_, request.requester, request.responder, request.burnFrom, request.amount);
    emit LibERC20.Transfer(request.burnFrom, address(0), request.amount);
  }

  function _rejectBurn(bytes32 requestId_, address requester_) internal {
    bytes32 internalRequestId = LibFactBase._generateID(requestId_, requester_);
    LibFactBase.Request memory request = LibFactBase._getRequest(internalRequestId);
    require(request.requester == requester_, "FACT0701");
    require(request.requestStatus == LibFactBase.RequestStatus.PENDING, "FACT0701");
    require(request.requestType == LibFactBase.RequestType.BURN, "FACT0709");
    request.responder = msg.sender;
    request.requestStatus = LibFactBase.RequestStatus.REJECTED;
    LibFactBase.ref()._requests[request.requestId] = request;

    LibERC20._transfer(request.burnFrom, request.requester, request.amount);

    emit BurnRejected(requestId_, request.requester, request.responder, request.burnFrom, request.amount);
  }

  function _approveBurnAllowance(address requester_, address delegate_, uint256 amount_) internal {
    require(requester_ != address(0), "FACT0703");
    require(delegate_ != address(0), "FACT0704");
    ref()._burnAllowances[requester_][delegate_] = amount_;

    emit RequestBurnApproval(requester_, delegate_, amount_);
  }

  function _decreaseRequestBurnAllowance(address requester_, address delegate_, uint256 subtractedValue_) internal {
    uint256 currentAllowance = ref()._burnAllowances[requester_][delegate_];
    require(currentAllowance >= subtractedValue_, "FACT0705");
    uint256 newAllowance = currentAllowance - subtractedValue_;
    _approveBurnAllowance(requester_, delegate_, newAllowance);
  }

  function _burnRequestAllowance(address requester_, address delegate_) internal view returns (uint256) {
    return ref()._burnAllowances[requester_][delegate_];
  }

  function _createBurnRequest(address requester_, uint256 amount_, bytes32 requestId_, address burnFrom_) internal {
    bytes32 internalRequestId = LibFactBase._generateID(requestId_, requester_);
    require(
      LibFactBase.ref()._requests[internalRequestId].requestStatus == LibFactBase.RequestStatus.UNINITIALIZED,
      "FACT0002"
    );
    LibFactBase.Request memory request = LibFactBase.Request(
      internalRequestId,
      LibFactBase.RequestType.BURN,
      LibFactBase.RequestStatus.PENDING,
      requester_,
      address(0),
      amount_,
      burnFrom_
    );
    LibFactBase.ref()._requests[internalRequestId] = request;

    emit BurnRequested(requestId_, requester_, burnFrom_, amount_);
  }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.17;

/******************************************************************************\
* Author: Nick Mudge <nick@perfectabstractions.com> (https://twitter.com/mudgen)
* EIP-2535 Diamonds: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2535
/******************************************************************************/
import {IDiamond} from "../interfaces/IDiamond.sol";
import {IDiamondCut} from "../interfaces/IDiamondCut.sol";

// Remember to add the loupe functions from DiamondLoupeFacet to the diamond.
// The loupe functions are required by the EIP2535 Diamonds standard

library LibDiamond {
  bytes32 private constant DIAMOND_STORAGE_POSITION = keccak256("fact.diamond.storage");

  struct FacetAddressAndSelectorPosition {
    address facetAddress;
    uint16 selectorPosition;
  }

  struct DiamondStorage {
    // function selector => facet address and selector position in selectors array
    mapping(bytes4 => FacetAddressAndSelectorPosition) facetAddressAndSelectorPosition;
    bytes4[] selectors;
    mapping(bytes4 => bool) supportedInterfaces;
    // owner of the contract
    address contractOwner;
    // pending owner of the contract
    address pendingContractOwner;
  }

  function diamondStorage() internal pure returns (DiamondStorage storage ds) {
    bytes32 position = DIAMOND_STORAGE_POSITION;
    assembly {
      ds.slot := position
    }
  }

  event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

  event OwnershipTransferStarted(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

  function transferOwnership(address _newOwner) internal {
    enforceIsContractOwner();
    setPendingContractOwner(_newOwner);
  }

  function acceptOwnership() internal {
    require(msg.sender != address(0), "DMND0016");
    enforceIsPendingContractOwner();
    setContractOwner(pendingContractOwner());
  }

  function renounceOwnership() internal {
    enforceIsContractOwner();
    setContractOwner(address(0));
  }

  function setPendingContractOwner(address _newOwner) internal {
    DiamondStorage storage ds = diamondStorage();
    ds.pendingContractOwner = _newOwner;
    emit OwnershipTransferStarted(ds.contractOwner, _newOwner);
  }

  function setContractOwner(address _newOwner) internal {
    DiamondStorage storage ds = diamondStorage();
    address previousOwner = ds.contractOwner;
    ds.contractOwner = _newOwner;
    ds.pendingContractOwner = address(0);
    emit OwnershipTransferred(previousOwner, _newOwner);
  }

  function contractOwner() internal view returns (address contractOwner_) {
    contractOwner_ = diamondStorage().contractOwner;
  }

  function pendingContractOwner() internal view returns (address pendingContractOwner_) {
    pendingContractOwner_ = diamondStorage().pendingContractOwner;
  }

  function enforceIsContractOwner() internal view {
    require(msg.sender == contractOwner(), "DMND0001");
  }

  function enforceIsPendingContractOwner() internal view {
    require(msg.sender == pendingContractOwner(), "DMND0018");
  }

  event DiamondCut(IDiamondCut.FacetCut[] _diamondCut, address _init, bytes _calldata);

  // Internal function version of diamondCut
  function diamondCut(IDiamondCut.FacetCut[] memory _diamondCut, address _init, bytes memory _calldata) internal {
    for (uint256 facetIndex = 0; facetIndex < _diamondCut.length; facetIndex++) {
      bytes4[] memory functionSelectors = _diamondCut[facetIndex].functionSelectors;
      address facetAddress = _diamondCut[facetIndex].facetAddress;
      require(functionSelectors.length != 0, "DMND0002");

      IDiamondCut.FacetCutAction action = _diamondCut[facetIndex].action;
      if (action == IDiamond.FacetCutAction.Add) {
        addFunctions(facetAddress, functionSelectors);
      } else if (action == IDiamond.FacetCutAction.Replace) {
        replaceFunctions(facetAddress, functionSelectors);
      } else if (action == IDiamond.FacetCutAction.Remove) {
        removeFunctions(facetAddress, functionSelectors);
      } else {
        revert("DMND0005");
      }
    }
    emit DiamondCut(_diamondCut, _init, _calldata);
    initializeDiamondCut(_init, _calldata);
  }

  function addFunctions(address _facetAddress, bytes4[] memory _functionSelectors) internal {
    require(_facetAddress != address(0), "DMND0003");

    DiamondStorage storage ds = diamondStorage();
    uint16 selectorCount = uint16(ds.selectors.length);
    enforceHasContractCode(_facetAddress);
    for (uint256 selectorIndex = 0; selectorIndex < _functionSelectors.length; selectorIndex++) {
      bytes4 selector = _functionSelectors[selectorIndex];
      address oldFacetAddress = ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[selector].facetAddress;
      require(oldFacetAddress == address(0), "DMND0006");

      ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[selector] = FacetAddressAndSelectorPosition(_facetAddress, selectorCount);
      ds.selectors.push(selector);
      selectorCount++;
    }
  }

  function replaceFunctions(address _facetAddress, bytes4[] memory _functionSelectors) internal {
    DiamondStorage storage ds = diamondStorage();
    require(_facetAddress != address(0), "DMND0007");

    enforceHasContractCode(_facetAddress);
    for (uint256 selectorIndex; selectorIndex < _functionSelectors.length; selectorIndex++) {
      bytes4 selector = _functionSelectors[selectorIndex];
      address oldFacetAddress = ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[selector].facetAddress;

      // can't replace immutable functions -- functions defined directly in the diamond in this case
      require(oldFacetAddress != address(this), "DMND0008");
      require(oldFacetAddress != _facetAddress, "DMND0009");
      require(oldFacetAddress != address(0), "DMND0010");
      // replace old facet address
      ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[selector].facetAddress = _facetAddress;
    }
  }

  function removeFunctions(address _facetAddress, bytes4[] memory _functionSelectors) internal {
    DiamondStorage storage ds = diamondStorage();
    uint256 selectorCount = ds.selectors.length;
    require(_facetAddress == address(0), "DMND0011");

    for (uint256 selectorIndex; selectorIndex < _functionSelectors.length; selectorIndex++) {
      bytes4 selector = _functionSelectors[selectorIndex];
      FacetAddressAndSelectorPosition memory oldFacetAddressAndSelectorPosition = ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[
        selector
      ];
      require(oldFacetAddressAndSelectorPosition.facetAddress != address(0), "DMND0012");

      // can't remove immutable functions -- functions defined directly in the diamond
      require(oldFacetAddressAndSelectorPosition.facetAddress != address(this), "DMND0013");

      // replace selector with last selector
      selectorCount--;
      if (oldFacetAddressAndSelectorPosition.selectorPosition != selectorCount) {
        bytes4 lastSelector = ds.selectors[selectorCount];
        ds.selectors[oldFacetAddressAndSelectorPosition.selectorPosition] = lastSelector;
        ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[lastSelector].selectorPosition = oldFacetAddressAndSelectorPosition
          .selectorPosition;
      }
      // delete last selector
      ds.selectors.pop();
      delete ds.facetAddressAndSelectorPosition[selector];
    }
  }

  function initializeDiamondCut(address _init, bytes memory _calldata) internal {
    if (_init == address(0)) {
      return;
    }
    enforceHasContractCode(_init);
    (bool success, bytes memory error) = _init.delegatecall(_calldata);
    if (!success) {
      if (error.length > 0) {
        // bubble up error
        /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
        assembly {
          let returndata_size := mload(error)
          revert(add(32, error), returndata_size)
        }
      } else {
        revert("DMND0014");
      }
    }
  }

  function enforceHasContractCode(address _contract) internal view {
    uint256 contractSize;
    assembly {
      contractSize := extcodesize(_contract)
    }
    require(contractSize != 0, "DMND0004");
  }

  function setInititalContractOwner(address _newOwner) internal {
    DiamondStorage storage ds = diamondStorage();
    ds.contractOwner = _newOwner;
  }
}

library LibFactBase {
  bytes32 private constant FACT_BASE_STORAGE_POSITION = keccak256("fact.base.storage");

  /**
   * @notice Used to grant token admin access to an address
   * @dev Defines role in AccessControlEnumerable

  bytes32 public constant TOKEN_ADMIN = keccak256("TOKEN_ADMIN");

  /**
   * @notice Used to grant account admin access to an address
   * @dev Defines role in AccessControlEnumerable
   */
  bytes32 public constant ACCOUNT_ADMIN = keccak256("ACCOUNT_ADMIN");

  /**
   * @notice Used to grant tokenization agent access to an address
   * @dev Defines role in AccessControlEnumerable
   */
  bytes32 public constant TOKENIZATION_AGENT = keccak256("TOKENIZATION_AGENT");

  /**
   * @notice Used to specify a burner address
   * @dev Defines role in AccessControlEnumerable
   */
  bytes32 public constant BURNER = keccak256("BURNER");

  /**
   * @notice A mint/burn request
   * @dev A new request struct is created for every mint/burn request and is never deleted
   *
   * @param requestId the unique identifier for the request
   * @param requestType the type of the request (mint/burn)
   * @param requestStatus thee status of the request (uninitialized, pending, approved, rejected)
   * @param requester address that made the request
   * @param responder address that acted on the request
   * @param amount the number of tokens requested
   * @param burnFrom address to which tokens are transferred to and from which tokens will be burned
   */
  struct Request {
    bytes32 requestId;
    RequestType requestType;
    RequestStatus requestStatus;
    address requester;
    address responder;
    uint256 amount;
    address burnFrom;
  }

  /**
   * @notice The request type
   *
   * @dev MINT identifies request to be used for minting requests
   * @dev BURN identifies request to be used for burning requests
   */
  enum RequestType {
    MINT,
    BURN
  }

  /**
   * @notice The request status
   *
   * @dev UNINITIALIZED request does not exist
   * @dev PENDING request has been made, but has not been acted on
   * @dev APPROVED request has been accepted
   * @dev REJECTED request has been rejected
   */
  enum RequestStatus {
    UNINITIALIZED,
    PENDING,
    APPROVED,
    REJECTED
  }

  struct FactTokenStorage {
    /**
     * @notice Mint/Burn requests
     * @dev Requests should NEVER be deleted from this mapping
     */
    mapping(bytes32 => Request) _requests;
  }

  function ref() internal pure returns (FactTokenStorage storage s) {
    bytes32 position = FACT_BASE_STORAGE_POSITION;
    assembly {
      s.slot := position
    }
  }

  function _getTokenAdmin() internal pure returns (bytes32) {
    return TOKEN_ADMIN;
  }

  function _getAccountAdmin() internal pure returns (bytes32) {
    return ACCOUNT_ADMIN;
  }

  function _getTokenizationAgent() internal pure returns (bytes32) {
    return TOKENIZATION_AGENT;
  }

  function _getBurner() internal pure returns (bytes32) {
    return BURNER;
  }

  function _requestOf(
    bytes32 requestId_,
    address requester_,
    LibFactBase.RequestType requestType_
  ) internal view returns (uint256 status_, address responder_, uint256 amount_) {
    bytes32 internalRequestId = LibFactBase._generateID(requestId_, requester_);
    LibFactBase.Request memory request = ref()._requests[internalRequestId];

    require(request.requestStatus != LibFactBase.RequestStatus.UNINITIALIZED, "FACT0000");
    require(request.requestType == requestType_, "FACT0001");

    return (uint256(request.requestStatus), request.responder, request.amount);
  }

  function _getRequest(bytes32 requestId_) internal view returns (LibFactBase.Request memory request_) {
    return LibFactBase.ref()._requests[requestId_];
  }

  function _generateID(bytes32 seed, address from) internal pure returns (bytes32 _id) {
    _id = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(seed, from));
  }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.17;
import {LibERC20} from "../libraries/LibERC20.sol";

import {EnumerableSet} from "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/structs/EnumerableSet.sol";

library LibManagedAccount {
  using EnumerableSet for EnumerableSet.AddressSet;

  bytes32 private constant MANAGED_ACCOUNT_STORAGE_POSITION = keccak256("fact.managedaccount.storage");

  address private constant LOCK_ADDRESS = address(uint160(uint256(keccak256("fact.managedaccount.lock.address"))));

  struct ManagedAccountStorage {
    /**
     * @notice Status of an account (active/inactive)
     * @dev Should be set to true when an account needs to be frozen for business reasons (e.g. sanctions)
     */
    EnumerableSet.AddressSet _accountList;
    /**
     * @notice Balance of tokens that have been locked but have not been force burned
     * @dev Represent a number of tokens that are part of the total supply but may be removed
     */
    mapping(address => uint256) _lockBalances;
    /**
     * @notice Status of an account on block list
     * @dev Set to true when an account is blocked
     * @dev Expectation is that _isBlockList will not change after initialization
     */
    bool _isBlockList;
  }

  event AccountActivated(address indexed caller_, address indexed account_);

  event AccountDeactivated(address indexed caller_, address indexed account_);

  event AccountActivatedBatch(address caller_, address[] accounts_);

  event AccountDeactivatedBatch(address caller_, address[] accounts_);

  event Locked(address indexed caller_, address indexed owner_, uint256 amount_);

  event LockedBatch(address indexed caller_, address[] owners_, uint256[] amounts_);

  event Unlocked(address indexed caller_, address indexed owner_, uint256 amount_);

  event UnlockedBatch(address indexed caller_, address[] owners_, uint256[] amounts_);

  event ForceBurned(address indexed caller_, address indexed owner_, uint256 amount_);

  event ForceBurnedBatch(address indexed caller_, address[] owners_, uint256[] amounts_);

  event ForceTransferred(address indexed caller_, address indexed owner_, address indexed newOwner_, uint256 amount_);

  event ForceTransferredBatch(address indexed caller_, address[] owners_, address[] newOwners_, uint256[] amounts_);

  function ref() internal pure returns (ManagedAccountStorage storage s) {
    bytes32 position = MANAGED_ACCOUNT_STORAGE_POSITION;
    assembly {
      s.slot := position
    }
  }

  function _accountActive(address requestor_) internal view returns (bool active_) {
    if (ref()._isBlockList) {
      return (!ref()._accountList.contains(requestor_));
    } else {
      return (ref()._accountList.contains(requestor_));
    }
  }

  function _activateAccount(address owner_) internal {
    require(owner_ != address(0), "FACT0205");
    require(!_accountActive(owner_), "FACT0201");
    if (ref()._isBlockList) {
      ref()._accountList.remove(owner_);
    } else {
      ref()._accountList.add(owner_);
    }
    emit AccountActivated(msg.sender, owner_);
  }

  function _batchActivateAccount(address[] calldata owners_) internal {
    for (uint256 i = 0; i < owners_.length; i++) {
      require(owners_[i] != address(0), "FACT0205");
      require((!_accountActive(owners_[i])), "FACT0201");
      if (ref()._isBlockList) {
        ref()._accountList.remove(owners_[i]);
      } else {
        ref()._accountList.add(owners_[i]);
      }
    }
    emit AccountActivatedBatch(msg.sender, owners_);
  }

  function _deactivateAccount(address owner_) internal {
    require(owner_ != address(0), "FACT0205");
    require(_accountActive(owner_), "FACT0200");
    if (ref()._isBlockList) {
      ref()._accountList.add(owner_);
    } else {
      ref()._accountList.remove(owner_);
    }
    emit AccountDeactivated(msg.sender, owner_);
  }

  function _batchDeactivateAccount(address[] calldata owners_) internal {
    for (uint256 i = 0; i < owners_.length; i++) {
      require(owners_[i] != address(0), "FACT0205");
      require(_accountActive(owners_[i]), "FACT0200");
      if (ref()._isBlockList) {
        ref()._accountList.add(owners_[i]);
      } else {
        ref()._accountList.remove(owners_[i]);
      }
    }
    emit AccountDeactivatedBatch(msg.sender, owners_);
  }

  function _lockBalanceOf(address owner_) internal view returns (uint256 balance_) {
    return ref()._lockBalances[owner_];
  }

  function _lock(address owner_, uint256 amount_) internal {
    require(owner_ != address(0), "FACT0205");
    require(amount_ > 0, "FACT0206");
    require(LibERC20.ref()._balances[owner_] >= amount_, "FACT0202");
    LibERC20.ref()._balances[owner_] -= amount_;
    ref()._lockBalances[owner_] += amount_;
    emit Locked(msg.sender, owner_, amount_);
    emit LibERC20.Transfer(owner_, LOCK_ADDRESS, amount_);
  }

  function _batchLock(address[] calldata owners_, uint256[] calldata amounts_) internal {
    require(owners_.length == amounts_.length, "FACT0203");
    for (uint256 i = 0; i < owners_.length; i++) {
      require(owners_[i] != address(0), "FACT0205");
      require(amounts_[i] > 0, "FACT0206");
      require(LibERC20.ref()._balances[owners_[i]] >= amounts_[i], "FACT0202");
      LibERC20.ref()._balances[owners_[i]] -= amounts_[i];
      ref()._lockBalances[owners_[i]] += amounts_[i];
      emit LibERC20.Transfer(owners_[i], LOCK_ADDRESS, amounts_[i]);
    }
    emit LockedBatch(msg.sender, owners_, amounts_);
  }

  function _unlock(address owner_, uint256 amount_) internal {
    require(owner_ != address(0), "FACT0205");
    require(amount_ > 0, "FACT0206");
    require(ref()._lockBalances[owner_] >= amount_, "FACT0202");
    ref()._lockBalances[owner_] -= amount_;
    LibERC20.ref()._balances[owner_] += amount_;
    emit Unlocked(msg.sender, owner_, amount_);
    emit LibERC20.Transfer(LOCK_ADDRESS, owner_, amount_);
  }

  function _batchUnlock(address[] calldata owners_, uint256[] calldata amounts_) internal {
    require(owners_.length == amounts_.length, "FACT0203");
    for (uint256 i = 0; i < owners_.length; i++) {
      require(owners_[i] != address(0), "FACT0205");
      require(amounts_[i] > 0, "FACT0206");
      require(ref()._lockBalances[owners_[i]] >= amounts_[i], "FACT0202");
      ref()._lockBalances[owners_[i]] -= amounts_[i];
      LibERC20.ref()._balances[owners_[i]] += amounts_[i];
      emit LibERC20.Transfer(LOCK_ADDRESS, owners_[i], amounts_[i]);
    }
    emit UnlockedBatch(msg.sender, owners_, amounts_);
  }

  function _forceBurn(address owner_, uint256 amount_) internal {
    require(owner_ != address(0), "FACT0205");
    require(amount_ > 0, "FACT0206");
    require(ref()._lockBalances[owner_] >= amount_, "FACT0202");
    ref()._lockBalances[owner_] -= amount_;
    LibERC20.ref()._totalSupply -= amount_;
    emit ForceBurned(msg.sender, owner_, amount_);
    emit LibERC20.Transfer(LOCK_ADDRESS, address(0), amount_);
  }

  function _batchForceBurn(address[] calldata owners_, uint256[] calldata amounts_) internal {
    require(owners_.length == amounts_.length, "FACT0203");
    for (uint256 i = 0; i < owners_.length; i++) {
      require(owners_[i] != address(0), "FACT0205");
      require(amounts_[i] > 0, "FACT0206");
      require(ref()._lockBalances[owners_[i]] >= amounts_[i], "FACT0202");
      ref()._lockBalances[owners_[i]] -= amounts_[i];
      LibERC20.ref()._totalSupply -= amounts_[i];
      emit LibERC20.Transfer(LOCK_ADDRESS, address(0), amounts_[i]);
    }
    emit ForceBurnedBatch(msg.sender, owners_, amounts_);
  }

  function _forceTransfer(address owner_, address newOwner_, uint256 amount_) internal {
    require(newOwner_ != address(0), "FACT0204");
    require(owner_ != address(0), "FACT0205");
    require(amount_ > 0, "FACT0206");
    require(ref()._lockBalances[owner_] >= amount_, "FACT0202");
    ref()._lockBalances[owner_] -= amount_;
    ref()._lockBalances[newOwner_] += amount_;
    emit ForceTransferred(msg.sender, owner_, newOwner_, amount_);
  }

  function _batchForceTransfer(
    address[] calldata owners_,
    address[] calldata newOwners_,
    uint256[] calldata amounts_
  ) internal {
    require(owners_.length == amounts_.length, "FACT0203");
    require(owners_.length == newOwners_.length, "FACT0203");

    for (uint256 i = 0; i < owners_.length; i++) {
      require(newOwners_[i] != address(0), "FACT0204");
      require(owners_[i] != address(0), "FACT0205");
      require(amounts_[i] > 0, "FACT0206");
      require(ref()._lockBalances[owners_[i]] >= amounts_[i], "FACT0202");
      ref()._lockBalances[owners_[i]] -= amounts_[i];
      ref()._lockBalances[newOwners_[i]] += amounts_[i];
    }
    emit ForceTransferredBatch(msg.sender, owners_, newOwners_, amounts_);
  }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.17;

import {LibFactBase} from "../libraries/LibFactBase.sol";
import {LibERC20} from "../libraries/LibERC20.sol";

library LibMintable {
  event Mint(bytes32 indexed requestId_, address indexed requester_, address indexed responder_, uint256 amount_);

  function _mint(bytes32 requestId_, address requester_, uint256 amount_) internal {
    bytes32 internalRequestId = LibFactBase._generateID(requestId_, requester_);
    require(
      LibFactBase.ref()._requests[internalRequestId].requestStatus == LibFactBase.RequestStatus.UNINITIALIZED,
      "FACT0002"
    );
    require(requester_ != address(0), "FACT0801");
    require(amount_ > 0, "FACT0800");

    _createMintRequest(requester_, msg.sender, amount_, internalRequestId);
    LibERC20.ref()._totalSupply += amount_;
    LibERC20.ref()._balances[requester_] += amount_;
    emit Mint(requestId_, requester_, msg.sender, amount_);
    emit LibERC20.Transfer(address(0), requester_, amount_);
  }

  function _createMintRequest(address requester_, address responder_, uint256 amount_, bytes32 requestId_) internal {
    LibFactBase.Request memory request = LibFactBase.Request(
      requestId_,
      LibFactBase.RequestType.MINT,
      LibFactBase.RequestStatus.APPROVED,
      requester_,
      responder_,
      amount_,
      address(0)
    );
    LibFactBase.ref()._requests[requestId_] = request;
  }
}
